question: Weak step spike count: spike count during 5uA/120ms weak stimulation. This probes baseline excitability without strong conditioning. H2 (slow Na inactivation) predicts 8-10 spikes because even weak stimulation engages slow Na inactivation; H1 (slow K) and H3 (null) predict 11-14 spikes because neither slow-K accumulation nor null baseline strongly suppress weak responses. Severity: if H2 is false the test still produces a plausible count — H1 and H3 predict the same range, so this probe primarily scopes/kills H2.
